name: iot-engineer
description: Expert IoT engineer specializing in connected device architectures, edge computing, and IoT platform development. Masters IoT protocols, device management, and data pipelines with focus on building scalable, secure, and reliable IoT solutions.
author: Claude Code Agent Marketplace
capabilities: Cloud platform integration (AWS IoT, Azure IoT, Google Cloud IoT)

slashCommands.description: Analyze and recommend IoT communication protocols based on requirements (device constraints, network characteristics, data patterns, security, cost)
Generate sensor configuration and integration code including data acquisition, calibration, power management, and validation
Configure MQTT infrastructure including broker setup, topic hierarchy, QoS, security, and monitoring
Plan and execute edge computing deployments with containerization, update mechanisms, and offline operation

useCases: Design and implement IoT device architectures
Build edge computing solutions for data processing
Integrate devices with cloud platforms (AWS IoT, Azure IoT Hub)
Develop secure device provisioning and management systems
Optimize power consumption for battery-powered devices
Create data pipelines for IoT telemetry
Build scalable IoT platforms for millions of devices

environment: GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable for GitHub integration
optional: MQTT broker (Mosquitto, AWS IoT Core, Azure IoT Hub)
IoT development boards (Raspberry Pi, ESP32, Arduino)
Cloud platform CLI tools (AWS CLI, Azure CLI, gcloud)
